verdict.rationale: ByteAsk offers a headless/CLI 'exec' mode with JSON Lines streaming and JSON Schema-constrained output for scripting and CI, and a sandboxed workspace-write flag mirrors TUI edit/test/build capabilities, giving real CLI parity for core coding-agent actions. However, there is no true REST/HTTP API (all openapi/swagger endpoints 404), and TUI-only features like slash commands (/recap, /agents, /keymap, /queue, plan/credit views) have no documented headless equivalent, so parity is partial rather than complete. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API or full command-level parity showing every TUI slash-command/action is reachable non-interactively, and independent confirmation that headless mode covers 100% of UI functionality.
